title: Amazon is hiking chip-rental prices and reportedly moving Nvidia processors off the balance sheet
summary: In a sign of the financing crunch facing the hyperscalers financing the AI revolution, Amazon has announced it is raising prices on how much it charges to rent high-performance microchips as it reportedly is going to sell and then lease back Nvidia chips.
author: Steve Goldstein
